1.1: Arbaa avot nezikin, hashshor vehabbor vehammave vehahever. lo hare hashshor kahare hammave, velo hare hammave kahare hashshor. velo ze vaze, sheyyesh bahen ruach chayyim, kahare haesh, sheen bo ruach chayyim. velo ze vaze, sheddarkan lelech ulehazzik, kahare habbor, sheen darko lelech ulehazzik. hatztzad hashshave shebbahen, sheddarkan lehazzik ushemiratan alecha. ucheshehizzik, chav hammazzik leshallem tashlume nezek bemetav haaretz:
1.2: Kol shechavti vishmirato, hichsharti et nizko. hichsharti vemiktzat nizko, chavti vetashlumin kehechsher kol nizko. nechasim sheen bahem meila, nechasim shel bene verit, nechasim hameyuchadim, uvechol makom chutz mershut hameyuchedet lammazzik ureshut hannizzak vehammazzik. ucheshehizzik, chav hammazzik leshallem tashlume nezek bemetav haaretz:
1.3: Shum kesef, veshave chesef, bifne vet din, veal pi edim bene chorin bene verit. vehannashim bichlal hannezek. vehannizzak vehammazzik battashlumin:
1.4: Chamishsha tammin vachamishsha muadin, habbehema enah muedet lo liggach velo liggof velo lishshoch velo lirbotz velo livot. hashshen muedet leechol et harauy lah, haregel muedet leshabber bederech hilluchah, veshor hammuad, veshor hammazzik birshut hannizzak, vehaadam. hazzeev vehaari vehaddov vehannamer vehabbardelas vehannachash, hare ellu muadin. rabbi eliezer omer, bizman shehen bene tarbut, enan muadin. vehannachash muad leolam. ma ben tam lemuad. ella shehattam meshallem chatzi nezek miggufo, umuad meshallem nezek shalem min haaliyya:

2.1: Ketzad haregel muedet. leshabber bederech hilluchah. habbehema muedet lehallech kedarkah uleshabber. hayta mevaetet, o shehayu tzerorot menattezin mittachat ragleha veshibbera et hakkelim, meshallem chatzi nezek. darsa al hakkeli veshibberatto, venafal al keli ushevaro, al harishon meshallem nezek shalem, veal haacharon meshallem chatzi nezek. hattarnegolim muadin lehallech kedarkan uleshabber. haya delil kashur beraglav, o shehaya mehaddes umeshabber et hakkelim, meshallem chatzi nezek:
2.2: Ketzad hashshen muedet. leechol et harauy lah. habbehema muedet leechol perot virakot. achla chesut o chelim, meshallem chatzi nezek. bamme devarim amurim. birshut hannizzak, aval birshut harabbim, patur. im nehenet, meshallem ma shennehenet. ketzad meshallem ma shennehenet. achla mittoch harchava, meshallem ma shennehenet. mitztzidde harchava, meshallem ma shehizzika. mippetach hachanut, meshallem ma shennehenet. mittoch hachanut, meshallem ma shehizzika:
2.3: Hakkelev vehaggedi shekkaftzu merosh haggag veshibberu et hakkelim, meshallem nezek shalem, mippene shehen muadin. hakkelev shennatal charara vehalach laggadish, achal hacharara vehidlik haggadish, al hacharara meshallem nezek shalem, veal haggadish meshallem chatzi nezek:
2.4: Eze hu tam, veeze hu muad. muad, kol sheheidu vo shelosha yamim. vetam, mishsheyyachazor bo shelosha yamim, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi meir omer, muad, sheheidu vo shalosh peamim. vetam, kol sheyyehu hattinokot memashmeshin bo veeno nogeach:
2.5: Shor hammazzik birshut hannizzak ketzad. nagach, nagaf, nashach, ravatz, baat, birshut harabbim, meshallem chatzi nezek. birshut hannizzak, rabbi tarfon omer nezek shalem, vachachamim omrim chatzi nezek. amar lahem rabbi tarfon, uma bimkom shehekel al hashshen veal haregel birshut harabbim, shehu fatur, hechmir alehem birshut hannizzak leshallem nezek shalem, mekom shehechmir al hakkeren birshut harabbim, leshallem chatzi nezek, eno din shennachmir aleha birshut hannizzak leshallem nezek shalem. amru lo, dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon, ma virshut harabbim chatzi nezek, af birshut hannizzak chatzi nezek. amar lahem, ani lo adun keren mikkeren, ani adun keren meregel. uma vimkom shehekel al hashshen veal haregel, birshut harabbim, hechmir bakkeren, mekom shehechmir al hashshen veal haregel, birshut hannizzak, eno din shennachmir bakkeren. amru lo, dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon, ma birshut harabbim chatzi nezek, af birshut hannizzak chatzi nezek:
2.6: Adam muad leolam, ben shogeg, ben mezid, ben er, ben yashen. simme et en chavero veshibber et hakkelim, meshallem nezek shalem:

3.1: Hammanniach et hakkad birshut harabbim uva acher venitkal bah ushevarah, patur. veim huzzak bah, baal hechavit chayyav benizko. nishbera chaddo birshut harabbim, vehuchlak echad bammayim, o shellaka vacharaseha, chayyav. rabbi yehuda omer, bemitkavven, chayyav. beeno mitkavven, patur:
3.2: Hashshofech mayim birshut harabbim, vehuzzak bahen acher, chayyav benizko. hammatznia et hakkotz, veet hazzechuchit, vehaggoder et gedero bekotzim, vegader shennafal lirshut harabbim, vehuzzeku vahen acherim, chayyav benizkan:
3.3: Hammotzi et tivno veet kashsho lirshut harabbim lizvalim, vehuzzak bahen acher, chayyav benizko, vechol hakkodem bahen zacha. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, kol hamekalkelin birshut harabbim vehizziku, chayyavin leshallem, vechol hakkodem bahen zacha. hahofech et haggalal birshut harabbim, vehuzzak bahen acher, chayyav benizko:
3.4: Shene kaddarin shehayu mehallechin ze achar ze, venitkal harishon venafal, venitkal hashsheni barishon, harishon chayyav benizke sheni:
3.5: Ze ba vechavito, veze ba vekorato, nishbera chaddo shel ze bekorato shel ze, patur, shellaze reshut lehallech velaze reshut lehallech. haya vaal kora rishon, uvaal chavit acharon, nishbera chavit bakkora, patur baal hakkora. veim amad baal hakkora, chayyav. veim amar levaal hechavit amod, patur. haya vaal chavit rishon uvaal kora acharon, nishbera chavit bakkora, chayyav. veim amad baal chavit, patur. veim amar levaal kora amod, chayyav. vechen ze va venero veze vefishtano:
3.6: Shenayim shehayu mehallechin birshut harabbim echad ratz veechad mehallech, o shehayu shenehem ratzim, vehizziku ze et ze, shenehem peturin:
3.7: Hamevakkea birshut hayyachid vehizzik birshut harabbim, birshut harabbim vehizzik birshut hayyachid, birshut hayyachid vehizzik birshut hayyachid acher, chayyav:
3.8: Shene shevarim tammim shechavlu ze et ze, meshallemim bammotar chatzi nezek. shenehem muadim, meshallemim bammotar nezek shalem. echad tam veechad muad, muad battam meshallem bammotar nezek shalem, tam bammuad meshallem bammotar chatzi nezek. vechen shene anashim shechavlu ze vaze, meshallemim bammotar nezek shalem. adam bemuad umuad beadam, meshallem bammotar nezek shalem. adam betam vetam beadam, adam betam meshallem bammotar nezek shalem, tam beadam meshallem bammotar chatzi nezek. rabbi akiva omer, af tam shechaval beadam, meshallem bammotar nezek shalem:
3.9: Shor shave mane shennagach shor shave matayim, veen hannevela yafa chelum, notel et hashshor. shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim, veen hannevela yafa chelum, amar rabbi meir, al ze neemar (Shemot 21) umachru et hashshor hachay vechatzu et kaspo. amar lo rabbi yehuda, vechen halacha, kiyyamta umachru et hashshor hachay vechatzu et kaspo, velo kiyyamta (sham) vegam et hammet yechetzun, veeze, ze shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim, vehannevela yafa chamishshim zuz, shezze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet, veze notel chatzi hachay vachatzi hammet:
3.10: Yesh chayyav al maase shoro ufatur al maase atzmo, patur al maase shoro vechayyav al maase atzmo. shoro shebbiyyesh, patur, vehu shebbiyyesh, chayyav. shoro shessimme et en avdo, vehippil et shinno, patur, vehu shessimme et en avdo, vehippil et shinno, chayyav. shoro shechaval beaviv veimmo, chayyav, vehu shechaval beaviv veimmo, patur. shoro shehidlik et haggadish beshabbat, chayyav, vehu shehidlik et haggadish beshabbat, patur, mippene shehu mitchayyev benafsho:
3.11: Shor shehaya rodef achar shor acher, vehuzzak, ze omer shorcha hizzik, veze omer lo chi, ella vesela laka, hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. hayu shenayim rodfim achar echad, ze omer shorcha hizzik, veze omer shorcha hizzik, shenehem peturin. im hayu shenehen shel ish echad, shenehen chayyavin. haya echad gadol veechad katan, hannizzak omer gadol hizzik, vehammazzik omer lo chi, ella katan hizzik. echad tam veechad muad, hannizzak omer, muad hizzik, vehammazzik omer lo chi, ella tam hizzik, hammotzi mechavero alav haraya. hayu hannizzokin shenayim, echad gadol veechad katan, vehammazzikim shenayim, echad gadol veechad katan, hannizzak omer, gadol hizzik et haggadol vekatan et hakkatan, umazzik omer lo chi, ella katan et haggadol vegadol et hakkatan. echad tam veechad muad, hannizzak omer, muad hizzik et haggadol vetam et hakkatan, vehammazzik omer lo chi, ella tam et haggadol umuad et hakkatan, hammotzi mechavero alav haraya:

4.1: Shor shennagach arbaa vachamishsha shevarim ze achar ze, yeshallem laacharon shebbahem. veim yesh bo motar, yachazir leshellefanav. veim yesh bo motar, yachazir leshellifne fanav. vehaacharon acharon niskar, divre rabbi meir. rabbi shimon omer, shor shave matayim shennagach shor shave matayim, veen hannevela yafa chelum, ze notel mane veze notel mane. chazar venagach shor acher shave matayim, haacharon notel mane, veshellefanav, ze notel chamishshim zuz veze notel chamishshim zuz. chazar venagach shor acher shave matayim, haacharon notel mane, veshellefanav, chamishshim zuz, ushenayim harishonim, dinar zahav:
4.2: Shor shehu muad lemino veeno muad lesheeno mino, muad leadam veeno muad livhema, muad liktannim veeno muad ligdolim, et shehu muad lo meshallem nezek shalem, veet sheeno muad lo meshallem chatzi nezek. amru lifne rabbi yehuda, hare shehaya muad leshabbatot veeno muad lechol. amar lahem, lashshabbatot meshallem nezek shalem, limot hachol meshallem chatzi nezek. ematay hu tam. mishsheyyachazor bo shelosha yeme shabbatot:
4.3: Shor shel yisrael shennagach shor shel hekdesh, veshel hekdesh shennagach leshor shel yisrael, patur, shenneemar (Shemot 21) shor reehu, velo shor shel hekdesh. shor shel yisrael shennagach leshor shel nachri, patur. veshel nachri shennagach leshor shel yisrael, ben tam ben muad meshallem nezek shalem:
4.4: Shor shel pikkeach shennagach shor shel cheresh, shote vekatan, chayyav. veshel cheresh, shote vekatan, shennagach shor shel pikkeach, patur. shor shel cheresh, shote vekatan shennagach, bet din maamidin lahen appotroppos umeidin lahen bifne appotroppos. nitpakkach hacheresh, nishtappa hashshote vehigdil hakkatan, chazar letammuto, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yose omer, hare hu vechezkato. shor haitztadin eno chayyav mita, shenneemar (Shemot 21) ki yiggach, velo sheyyaggichuhu:
4.5: Shor shennagach et haadam vamet, muad, meshallem kofer, vetam, patur min hakkofer. veze vaze chayyavim mita. vechen beven vechen bevat. nagach eved o ama, noten sheloshim selaim, ben shehu yafe mane uven sheeno yafe ella dinar echad:
4.6: Shor shehaya mitchakkech bechotel venafal al haadam, nitkavven laharog et habbehema veharag et haadam, lenachri veharag et yisrael, linfalim veharag ben keyama, patur:
4.7: Shor haishsha, shor hayetomim, shor haappotroppos, shor hammidbar, shor hahekdesh, shor hagger shemmet veen lo yorshim, hare ellu chayyavim mita. rabbi yehuda omer, shor hammidbar, shor hahekdesh, shor hagger shemmet, peturim min hammita, lefi sheen lahem bealim:
4.8: Shor shehu yotze lehissakel vehikdisho vealav, eno mukdash. shechato, besaro asur. veim ad shello nigmar dino hikdisho vealav, mukdash. veim shechato, besaro muttar:
4.9: Mesaro leshomer chinnam, uleshoel, lenose sachar, ulesocher, nichnesu tachat habbealim, muad meshallem nezek shalem, vetam meshallem chatzi nezek. kesharo vealav bemosera, venaal befanav karauy, veyatza vehizzik, echad tam veechad muad chayyav, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, tam chayyav umuad patur, shenneemar (Shemot 21) velo yishmerennu bealav, veshamur hu ze. rabbi eliezer omer, en lo shemira ella sakkin:

5.1: Shor shennagach et happara venimtza ubbarah betziddah, veen yadua im ad shello negachah yalda, im mishshennegachah yalda, meshallem chatzi nezek lappara urevia nezek lavvalad. vechen para shennagcha et hashshor venimtza veladah betziddah, veen yadua im ad shello nagcha yalda, im mishshennagcha yalda, meshallem chatzi nezek min happara urevia nezek min havvalad:
5.2: Hakkaddar shehichnis kederotav lachatzar baal habbayit shello virshut, veshibberatan behemto shel baal habbayit, patur. veim huzzeka vahen, baal hakkederot chayyav. veim hichnis birshut, baal chatzer chayyav. hichnis perotav lachatzar baal habbayit shello virshut, vaachalatan behemto shel baal habbayit, patur. veim huzzeka vahen, baal happerot chayyav. veim hichnis birshut, baal hechatzer chayyav:
5.3: Hichnis shoro lachatzar baal habbayit shello virshut, unegacho shoro shel baal habbayit, o shenneshacho chalbo shel baal habbayit, patur. nagach hu shoro shel baal habbayit, chayyav. nafal levoro vehivish memav, chayyav. haya aviv o veno letocho, meshallem et hakkofer. veim hichnis birshut, baal hechatzer chayyav. rabbi omer, bechullan eno chayyav, ad sheyyekabbel alav lishmor:
5.4: Shor shehaya mitkavven lachavero vehikka et haishsha veyatzu yeladeha, patur middeme veladot. veadam shehaya mitkavven lachavero vehikka et haishsha veyatzu yeladeha, meshallem deme veladot. ketzad meshallem deme veladot, shamin et haishsha kamma hi yafa ad shello yalda vechamma hi yafa mishsheyyalada. amar rabban shimon ben gamliel, im ken, mishshehaishsha yoledet, mashbachat. ella shamin et havveladot kamma hen yafin, venoten labbaal. veim en lah baal, noten leyorshav. hayta shifcha venishtachrera, o giyyoret, patur:
5.5: Hachofer bor birshut hayyachid ufetacho lirshut harabbim, o virshut harabbim ufetacho lirshut hayyachid, birshut hayyachid ufetacho lirshut hayyachid acher, chayyav. hachofer bor birshut harabbim, venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet, chayyav. echad hachofer bor, shiach umeara, charitzin uneitzin, chayyav. im ken, lamma neemar bor, ma bor sheyyesh bo chede lehamit, asara tefachim, af kol sheyyesh bo chede lehamit, asara tefachim. hayu fechutin measara tefachim, venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet, patur. veim huzzak bo, chayyav:
5.6: Bor shel shene shuttafin, avar alav harishon velo chissahu, vehashsheni velo chissahu, hashsheni chayyav. kissahu harishon, uva hashsheni umetzao megulle velo chissahu, hashsheni chayyav. kissahu charauy, venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet, patur. lo chissahu charauy, venafal letocho shor o chamor vamet, chayyav. nafal lefanav mikkol hakkeriyya, chayyav. leacharav mikkol hakkeriyya, patur. nafal letocho shor vechelav venishtabberu, chamor vechelav venitkaru, chayyav al habbehema ufatur al hakkelim. nafal letocho shor cheresh, shote vekatan, chayyav. ben o vat, eved o ama, patur:
5.7: Echad shor veechad kol behema linfilat habbor, ulehafrashat har sinay, uletashlume chefel, velahashavat aveda, lifrika, lachasima, lechilayim, uleshabbat. vechen chayya vaof kayyotze vahen. im ken, lamma neemar shor o chamor. ella sheddibber hakkatuv bahove:

6.1: Hakkones tzon laddir, venaal befaneha karauy, veyatza vehizzika, patur. lo naal befaneha karauy, veyatza vehizzika, chayyav. nifretza vallayla o shepperatzuha listim, veyatza vehizzika, patur. hotziuha listim, listim chayyavim:
6.2: Hinnichah bachamma, o shemmesarah lecheresh, shote vekatan, veyatza vehizzika, chayyav. mesarah leroe, nichnas roe tachtav. nafla leginna venehenet, meshallemet ma shennehenet. yarda chedarkah vehizzika, meshallemet ma shehizzika. ketzad meshallemet ma shehizzika, shamin bet sea beota sade, kamma hayta yafa vechamma hi yafa. rabbi shimon omer, achla perot gemurim meshallemet perot gemurim. im sea sea, im satayim satayim:
6.3: Hammagdish betoch sade shel chavero shello virshut, vaachalatan behemto shel baal hassade, patur. veim huzzeka vahen, baal haggadish chayyav. veim higdish birshut, baal hassade chayyav:
6.4: Hashsholeach et habbeera beyad cheresh, shote vekatan, patur bedine adam vechayyav bedine shamayim. shalach beyad pikkeach, happikkeach chayyav. echad hevi et haur, veechad hevi et haetzim, hammevi et haetzim chayyav. echad hevi et haetzim, veechad hevi et haur, hammevi et haur chayyav. ba acher velibba, hammelabbe chayyav. libbeta haruach, kullan peturin. hashsholeach et habbeera veachla etzim, o avanim, o afar, chayyav, shenneemar (Shemot 22) ki tetze esh umatza kotzim veneechal gadish o hakkama o hassade, shallem yeshallem hammavir et habbeera. avra gader shehu gavoah arba ammot, o derech harabbim, o nahar, patur. hammadlik betoch shello, ad kamma taavor haddeleka. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, roin oto keilu hu veemtza bet kor. rabbi eliezer omer, shesh esre ammot, kederech reshut harabbim. rabbi akiva omer, chamishshim amma. rabbi shimon omer, shallem yeshallem hammavir et habbeera (Shemot 22), hakkol lefi haddeleka:
6.5: Hammadlik et haggadish, vehayu bo chelim vedalaku. rabbi yehuda omer, yeshallem ma shebbetocho. vachachamim omrim, eno meshallem ella gadish shel chittin o shel seorim. haya gedi chafut lo veeved samuch lo venisraf immo, chayyav. eved kafut lo ugedi samuch lo venisraf immo, patur. umodim chachamim lerabbi yehuda bemadlik et habbira, shehu meshallem kol ma shebbetocho, shekken derech bene adam lehanniach babbattim:
6.6: Getz sheyyatza mittachat happattish vehizzik, chayyav. gamal shehaya taun pishtan veavar birshut harabbim, venichnas pishtano letoch hachanut, vedalku benero shel chenvani vehidlik et habbira, baal haggamal chayyav. hinniach chenvani nero mibbachutz, hachenvani chayyav. rabbi yehuda omer, bener chanukka patur:

7.1: Merubba middat tashlume chefel mimmiddat tashlume arbaa vachamishsha, shemmiddat tashlume chefel noheget ben bedavar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim uven bedavar sheen bo ruach chayyim, umiddat tashlume arbaa vachamishsha enah noheget ella beshor vase bilvad, shenneemar (Shemot 21) ki yignov ish shor o se utevacho o mecharo vegomer. en haggonev achar haggannav meshallem tashlume chefel, velo hattoveach velo hammocher achar haggannav meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha:
7.2: Ganav al pi shenayim, vetavach umachar al pihem o al pi shenayim acherim, meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. ganav umachar beshabbat, ganav umachar laavoda zara, ganav vetavach beyom hakkippurim, ganav mishshel aviv vetavach umachar veachar kach met aviv, ganav vetavach veachar kach hikdish, meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. ganav vetavach lirfua o lichlavim, hashshochet venimtza terefa, hashshochet chullin baazara, meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. rabbi shimon poter bishne ellu:
7.3: Ganav al pi shenayim vetavach umachar al pihem, venimtzeu zommin, meshallemin hakkol. ganav al pi shenayim vetavach umachar al pi shenayim acherim, ellu veellu nimtzeu zommin, harishonim meshallemim tashlume chefel, vehaacharonim meshallemin tashlume shelosha. nimtzeu acharonim zommin, hu meshallem tashlume chefel, vehen meshallemin tashlume shelosha. echad min haacharonim zomem, batla edut sheniyya. echad min harishonim zomem, batla kol haedut, sheim en geneva en tevicha veen mechira:
7.4: Ganav al pi shenayim, vetavach umachar al pi ed echad, o al pi atzmo, meshallem tashlume chefel, veeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. ganav vetavach beshabbat, ganav vetavach laavoda zara, ganav mishshel aviv, umet aviv, veachar kach tavach umachar, ganav vehikdish veachar kach tavach umachar, meshallem tashlume chefel veeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. rabbi shimon omer, kadashim shechayyav beacharayutam, meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. sheen chayyav beacharayutam, patur:
7.5: Mecharo chutz meechad mimmea shebbo, o shehayta lo vo shuttafut, hashshochet venitnabbela veyado, hannocher, vehameakker, meshallem tashlume chefel veeno meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. ganav birshut habbealim vetavach umachar chutz mershutam, o shegganav chutz mershutam vetavach umachar birshutam, o shegganav vetavach umachar chutz mershutam, meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha. aval ganav vetavach umachar birshutam, patur:
7.6: Haya moshcho veyotze, umet birshut habbealim, patur. higbiho o shehotzio mershut habbealim, umet, chayyav. netano livchorot beno o levaal chovo, leshomer chinnam, uleshoel, lenose sachar, ulesocher, vehaya moshcho, umet birshut habbealim, patur. higbiho o shehotzio mershut habbealim, umet, chayyav:
7.7: En megaddelin behema dakka beeretz yisrael, aval megaddelin besureya, uvammidbarot shebbeeretz yisrael. en megaddelin tarnegolim birushalayim, mippene hakkadashim, velo chohanim beeretz yisrael, mippene hattohorot. en megaddelin chazirim bechol makom. lo yegaddel adam et hakkelev, ella im ken haya kashur beshalshelet. en porsin nishbim layyonim. ella im ken haya rachok min hayyishshuv sheloshim ris:

8.1: Hachovel bachavero chayyav alav mishshum chamishsha devarim, benezek, betzaar, berippuy, beshevet, uvevoshet. benezek ketzad. simma et eno, kata et yado, shibber et raglo, roin oto keillu hu eved nimkar bashshuk veshamin kamma haya yafe vechamma hu yafe. tzaar, kevao veshappud o vemasmer, vaafillu al tzipparno, mekom sheeno ose chabbura, omdin kamma adam kayyotze vaze rotze littol lihyot mitztaer kach. rippuy, hikkahu chayyav lerappeoto. alu vo tzemachim, im mechamat hammakka, chayyav. shello mechamat hammakka, patur. chayta venistera, chayta venistera, chayyav lerappeoto. chayta chol tzarkah, eno chayyav lerappeoto. shevet, roin oto keilu hu shomer kishshuin, shekkevar natan lo deme yado udeme raglo. boshet, hakkol lefi hamevayyesh vehammitbayyesh. hamevayyesh et hearom, hamevayyesh et hassuma, vehamevayyesh et hayyashen, chayyav. veyashen shebbiyyesh, patur. nafal min haggag, vehizzik uviyyesh, chayyav al hannezek ufatur al habboshet, shenneemar (Devarim 25) veshalcha yadah vehechezika bimvushav, eno chayyav al habboshet ad sheyhe mitkavven:
8.2: Ze chomer baadam mibbashshor, shehaadam meshallem nezek, tzaar, rippuy, shevet, uvoshet, umeshallem deme veladot, veshor eno meshallem ella nezek, ufatur middeme veladot:
8.3: Hammakke et aviv veet immo velo asa vahem chabbura, vechovel bachavero beyom hakkippurim, chayyav bechullan. hachovel beeved ivri, chayyav bechullan chutz min hashshevet, bizman shehu shello. hachovel beeved kenaani shel acherim, chayyav bechullan. rabbi yehuda omer, en laavadim boshet:
8.4: Cheresh, shote vekatan, pegiatan raa. hachovel bahen chayyav, vehem shechavlu baacherim peturin. haeved vehaishsha, pegiatan raa. hachovel bahen chayyav, vehem shechavlu baacherim, peturin, aval meshallemin leachar zeman. nitgarsha haishsha, nishtachrer haeved, chayyavin leshallem:
8.5: Hammakke aviv veimmo veasa vahen chabbura, vehachovel bachavero beshabbat, patur mikkullan, mippene shehu niddon benafsho. vehachovel beeved kenaani shello, patur mikkullan:
8.6: Hattokea lachavero, noten lo sela. rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yose haggelili, mane. setaro, noten lo matayim zuz. leachar yado, noten lo arba meot zuz. tzaram beazno, talash bisaro, rakak vehiggia bo rukko, heevir tallito mimmennu, para rosh haishsha bashshuk, noten arba meot zuz. ze hakkelal hakkol lefi chevodo. amar rabbi akiva, afilu aniyyim shebbeyisrael, roin otam keillu hem bene chorin sheyyardu minnichsehem, shehem bene avraham, yitzchak veyaakov. umaase beechad sheppara rosh haishsha bashshuk, bat lifne rabbi akiva, vechiyyevo litten lah arba meot zuz. amar lo rabbi, ten li zeman. venatan lo zeman. shemarah omedet al petach chatzerah veshavar et hakkad befaneha, uvo keissar shemen. gilleta et roshah, vehayta metappachat umannachat yadah al roshah. heemid aleha edim, uva lifne rabbi akiva. amar lo, rabbi, lazo ani noten arba meot zuz. amar lo, lo amarta kelum. hachovel beatzmo, af al pi sheeno rashshay, patur. acherim shechavlu bo, chayyavin. vehakkotzetz netiotav, af al pi sheeno rashshay, patur. acherim shekkatztzu et netiotav, chayyavim:
8.7: Af al pi shehu noten lo, en nimchal lo ad sheyyevakkesh mimmennu, shenneemar (Bereshit 20) veatta hashev eshet vegomer. uminnayin shello yehe hammochel achzari, shenneemar (sham) vayyitpallel avraham el haelohim vayyirpa elohim et avimelech vegomer. haomer samme et eni, keta et yadi, shevor et ragli, chayyav. al menat liftor, chayyav. kera et kesuti, shevor et kaddi, chayyav. al menat liftor, patur. ase chen leish peloni, al menat liftor, chayyav, ben begufo ben bemamono:

9.1: Haggozel etzim, vaasaan kelim, tzemer, vaasaan begadim, meshallem kishat haggezela. gazal para meubberet, veyalda, rachel teuna, ugezazah, meshallem deme fara haomedet leled, deme rachel haomedet liggazez. gazal para, venitabbera etzlo veyalda, rachel, venitana etzlo ugezazah, meshallem kishat haggezela. ze hakkelal, kol haggazlanim meshallemin kishat haggezela:
9.2: Gazal behema vehizkina, avadim vehizkinu, meshallem kishat haggezela. rabbi meir omer, baavadim omer lo, hare shellecha lefanecha. gazal matbea venisdak, perot vehirkivu, yayin vehechmitz, meshallem kishat haggezela. matbea venifsal, teruma venitmet, chametz veavar alav happesach, behema veneevda vah avera, o shennifsela meal gabbe hammizbeach, o shehayta yotzet lissakel, omer lo, hare shellecha lefanecha:
9.3: Natan leummanin letakken, vekilkelu, chayyavin leshallem. natan lecharash shidda, teva umigdal letakken, vekilkel, chayyav leshallem. vehabbannay shekkibbel alav listor et hakkotel, veshibber et haavanim o shehizzik, chayyav leshallem. haya soter mitztzad ze venafal mitztzad acher, patur. veim mechamat hammakka, chayyav:
9.4: Hannoten tzemer letzabba, vehikdichato yora, noten lo deme tzamro. tzevao chaur, im hashshevach yoter al hayetzia, noten lo et hayetzia, veim hayetzia yetera al hashshevach, noten lo et hashshevach. litzboa lo adom, utzevao shachor, shachor, utzevao adom, rabbi meir omer, noten lo deme tzamro. rabbi yehuda omer, im hashshevach yater al hayetzia, noten lo et hayetzia, veim hayetzia yetera al hashshevach, noten lo et hashshevach:
9.5: Haggozel et chavero shave feruta, venishba lo, yolichennu acharav afillu lemaday. lo yitten lo livno velo lishlucho, aval noten lishliach bet din. veim met, yachazir leyorshav:
9.6: Natan lo et hakkeren velo natan lo et hachomesh, machal lo al hakkeren velo machal lo al hachomesh, machal lo al ze veal ze chutz mippachot mishshave feruta vakkeren, eno tzarich lelech acharav. natan lo et hachomesh velo natan lo et hakkeren, machal lo al hachomesh velo machal lo al hakkeren, machal lo al ze veal ze chutz mishshave feruta vakkeren, tzarich lelech acharav:
9.7: Natan lo et hakkeren venishba lo al hachomesh, hare ze meshallem chomesh al chomesh, ad sheyyitmaet hakkeren pachot mishshave feruta. vechen befikkadon, shenneemar (Vayikra 5) befikkadon o vitsumet yad o vegazel o ashak et amito o matza aveda vechichesh bah venishba al shaker, hare ze meshallem keren vachomesh veasham. hechan pikdoni, amar lo avad, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, vehaedim meidim oto sheachalo, meshallem keren. hoda meatzmo, meshallem keren vachomesh veasham:
9.8: Hechan pikdoni, amar lo nignav, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, vehaedim meidin oto sheggenavo, meshallem tashlume chefel. hoda meatzmo, meshallem keren vachomesh veasham:
9.9: Haggozel et aviv, venishba lo, umet, hare ze meshallem keren vachomesh levanav o leechav. veim eno rotze, o sheen lo, love uvaale chov baim venifraim:
9.10: Haomer livno, konam i atta nehene mishshelli, im met, yirashennu. bechayyav uvemoto, im met, lo yirashennu, veyachazir levanav o leechav. veim en lo, love, uvaale chov baim venifraim:
9.11: Haggozel et hagger venishba lo, umet, hare ze meshallem keren vachomesh lakkohanim veasham lammizbeach, shenneemar (Bamidbar 5) veim en laish goel lehashiv haasham elav, haasham hammushav laAdonai lakkohen, millevad el hakkippurim asher yechapper bo alav. haya maale et hakkesef veet haasham, umet, hakkesef yinnaten levanav, vehaasham yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher veyippelu damav lindava:
9.12: Natan hakkesef leanshe mishmar, umet, en hayyorshim yecholin lehotzi miyyadam, shenneemar (sham) ish asher yitten lakkohen lo yihye. natan hakkesef lihoyariv veasham lidaya, yatza. asham lihoyariv vechesef lidaya, im kayyam haasham, yakrivuhu vene yedaya, veim lo, yachazir veyavi asham acher, shehammevi gezelo ad shello hevi ashamo, yatza. hevi ashamo ad shello hevi gezelo, lo yatza. natan et hakkeren velo natan et hachomesh, en hachomesh meakkev:

10.1: Haggozel umaachil et banav, vehinniach lifnehem, peturin milleshallem. veim haya davar sheyyesh bo acharayut, chayyavin leshallem. en portin lo mittevat hammochsin, velo mikkis shel gabbain, veen notlin mehem tzedaka. aval notel hu mittoch beto o min hashshuk:
10.2: Natlu mochsin et chamoro venatnu lo chamor acher, gazlu listim et kesuto venatnu lo chesut acheret, hare ellu shello, mippene shehabbealim mityaashin mehen. hammatztzil min hannahar o min haggayis o min hallistim, im nityaashu habbealim, hare ellu shello. vechen nachil shel devorim, im nityaashu habbealim, hare ellu shello. amar rabbi yochanan ben beroka, neemenet ishsha o katan lomar, mikkan yatza nachil ze. umehallech betoch sede chavero lehatztzil et nechilo. veim hizzik, meshallem ma shehizzik. aval lo yakotz et socho al menat litten et haddamim. rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, af kotzetz venoten et haddamim:
10.3: Hammakkir kelav usefarav beyad acher, veyatza lo shem geneva bair, yishshava lo lokeach kamma natan, veyittol. veim lav, lo kol hemennu, sheani omer mecharan leacher ulekachan ze hemennu:
10.4: Ze ba vechavito shel yayin veze ba vechaddo shel devash. nisdeka chavit shel devash, veshafach ze et yeno vehitztzil et haddevash letocho, en lo ella secharo. veim amar, atztzil et shellecha veatta noten li deme shelli, chayyav litten lo. shataf nahar chamoro vachamor chavero, shello yafe mane veshel chavero matayim, hinniach ze et shello vehitztzil et shel chavero, en lo ella secharo. veim amar lo, ani atztzil et shellecha veatta noten li et shelli, chayyav litten lo:
10.5: Haggozel sade mechavero unetaluhu mesikin, im makkat medina hi, omer lo hare shellecha lefanecha, veim mechamat haggazlan, chayyav lehaamid lo sade acheret. shetafah nahar, omer lo, hare shellecha lefanecha:
10.6: Haggozel et chavero, o shellava hemennu, o shehifkid lo. bayyishshuv, lo yachazir lo vammidbar. al menat latzet bammidbar, yachazir lo vammidbar:
10.7: Haomer lachavero, gezalticha, hilvitani, hifkadta etzli, veeni yodea im hechezarti lecha im lo hechezarti lecha, chayyav leshallem. aval im amar lo, eni yodea im gezalticha, im hilvitani, im hifkadta etzli, patur milleshallem:
10.8: Haggonev tale min haeder vehecheziro, umet o nignav, chayyav beacharayuto. lo yadu vealim lo vignevato velo vachazirato, umanu et hatztzon ushelema hi, patur:
10.9: En lokchim min haroim tzemer vechalav ugedayim, velo mishshomre ferot etzim uferot. aval lokchin min hannashim kele tzemer bihuda, uchele fishtan baggalil, vaagalim bashsharon. vechullan sheamru lehatemin, asur. velokchin betzim vetarnegolim mikkol makom:
10.10: Mochin shehakkoves motzi, hare ellu shello. veshehassorek motzi, hare ellu shel baal habbayit. hakkoves notel shelosha chutin vehen shello. yater mikken, hare ellu shel baal habbayit. im haya hashshachor al gabbe hallavan, notel et hakkol vehen shello. hachayyat sheshshiyyer min hachut kede litpor bo, umatlit shehi shalosh al shalosh, hare ellu shel baal habbayit. ma shehecharash motzi vammaatzad, hare ellu shello, uvakkashshil, shel baal habbayit. veim haya ose etzel baal habbayit, af hannesoret shel baal habbayit:
